evidence.detail: The composed window course selects first.cpp (2 unread threads), second.cpp (1) and clean.cpp (0) through the file gesture/semantic dispatch; other files retain unread threads.

The first file counts two unread threads, rather than three unread posts or three review-wide threads; hide-resolved filtering does not change the count. Per-file caches match complete read-state projections at 32 and 4096 threads.

The course exercises file switches, Mark read dispatch, new unread update, selected-file clearing with a retained diff, refresh gap, forest replacement, authority invalidation and replacement selection.

qt_current_file_unread_badge and the existing GitHub composition/conversation courses pass. Full-window offscreen unread/clean-file PNGs were inspected. The global-count negative control fails the first-file count assertion; restored candidate passes.
